emails.subject: Thanks for Saturday's Waste Wise table
emails.body: Thanks for staffing the library foyer table on Saturday. We returned the folding sign holder to the storage closet, and there are no open room items from our side.

emails.subject: Evergreen poster pickup complete
emails.body: The December hallway poster copies were picked up by our front desk yesterday and placed on the approved bulletin board. This closes the small information-posting request for Evergreen.
